editorial:
If you love a messy love triangle with plenty of laughs, this one delivers. The story follows Dustin, a sweet but clingy guy who loses his dream girl Alexis after coming on too strong. Desperate to win her back, he convinces his best friend Tank to take her on the worst rebound date ever, hoping she'll run straight back to him. Tank agrees, but Alexis turns out to be tougher and more charming than expected, and soon Tank finds himself falling for her. The vibe is light, silly, and a little crude, with that classic mid-2000s rom-com energy. The chemistry between the leads keeps things moving, and the awkward situations pile up fast. It's the kind of movie you put on when you want something easy and fun without thinking too hard.

The acting is solid, especially the banter between the friends, and the pacing keeps the jokes coming. On the downside, some of the humor feels dated and a few scenes drag. Still, if you enjoy romantic comedies with a raunchy edge, you'll have a good time. Best watched with friends on a relaxed night in. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Tank confesses his real feelings for Alexis and quits his side job as a terrible date. Dustin is heartbroken at first but eventually accepts that his best friend and ex belong together. Alexis chooses Tank, and the two become a couple. Dustin moves on and finds happiness with someone new, wrapping up the love triangle with a happy ending for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves messy romantic comedies with a raunchy edge.
